Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is inclined to grant interim bail to the applicant herein for a period of two months, on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.10,000/- with one surety of the like amount, subject to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court/Successor Court/Link Court/Duty Judge concerned on the following terms and conditions:
i) The applicant shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned Court and if the applicant has a passport, he shall surrender the same to the concerned trial court.
ii) In case of change of residential address/contact details, the applicant shall promptly inform the same to the concerned Court and IO/SHO concerned.

iii) The applicant shall appear regularly before the learned Trial Court, unless exempted.
iv) The period of two months shall be counted from the date of release of the applicant.
v) The applicant shall immediately surrender before the learned Trial Court after expiry of the interim bail period.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 30/01/2026 at 20:50:43 6.
Accordingly, the present bail application stands allowed and is disposed of.
7. Order dasti under the signatures of the Court Master.
8. The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
DR. SWARANA KANTA SHARMA, J JANUARY 30, 2026/A/GJ
